subject: Customer Journey Live: GreenGrid — invite to share product story
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marquez <elena@greengrid.ai>
Cc: marketing@greengrid.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Customer Journey Live: GreenGrid — invite to share product story

Hi Elena,

It was great talking last week — thanks again for taking the time. We run a short 30–45 minute customer-focused webcast series ("Customer Journey Live") where a customer walks through a recent project and field questions from a small audience of product/infra engineers. The goal is to highlight real-world workloads and the operational/pricing wins teams have seen.

We'd love to invite GreenGrid to be a guest for a 30-minute slot in July. High-level details:
- Format: 20-minute presentation + 10-minute live Q&A
- Audience: ~50 product/platform engineers from energy and grid-tech companies
- Logistics: remote, we record, slides due 3 business days prior

Why we think this is a good fit: your team's recent deployment (shorter inference tails + predictable billing) maps well to the audience, and your metrics make for a compelling case study. We can cover speaker honorarium or travel if you prefer in-person at a future conference.

If you're open, could you confirm availability the week of July 13th? I've attached a one-pager with more context and a first-pass agenda.

Thanks — I'll loop in Rachel (CS) and Marcus (sales lead) for logistics.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: GG_Customer_OnePager.pdf
From: Elena Marquez <elena@greengrid.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Customer Journey Live: GreenGrid — invite to share product story

Neha,

Thanks for the invite — we'd be happy to participate. The week of July 13th looks promising; June/July is busy but I can carve out time. A couple notes from my side:
- We prefer a technical audience (ops/infra) — is the attendee mix adjustable?
- I'd like to bring our lead MLOps engineer, Carlos Rivera, to handle the deep-dive.
- Would you be able to share a sample speaker slide deck or template?

I can also confirm by end of day Friday once I align with Carlos and our comms lead (marketing@greengrid.ai).

Best,
Elena Marquez
Head of Product | GreenGrid Energy
elena@greengrid.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marquez <elena@greengrid.ai>
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, marketing@greengrid.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer Journey Live: GreenGrid — invite to share product story

Elena — perfect, glad it's a fit. Quick answers and a proposed next step: 

1) Audience: we can prioritize an ops/infra crowd and will screen registrants accordingly — I'll ask James from events to tag the invites.
2) Carlos is great — please do include him.
3) Attached is a draft agenda and a simple slide template we use. Slides are typically 10–12 slides for a 20-minute session.

Proposed date options (all 30-minute slots):
- Tue, July 14 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu, July 16 — 13:00–13:30 PT
- Wed, July 15 — 11:00–11:30 PT

Can you confirm which option works best? Once we lock the slot, Rachel will follow up on AV, recording, and the speaker agreement. We also have a short promotional blurb we'd like to run by you before the registration goes live.

Thanks — tagging Rachel and Marcus to start logistics.

-Neha

Attachments: Draft_Agenda_v1.docx
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marquez <elena@greengrid.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, marketing@greengrid.ai
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer Journey Live: GreenGrid — invite to share product story

Hi Elena (and Neha),

Thanks — quick logistics from our side:
- We can accommodate the ops-heavy audience and will include a couple screening questions on registration (team size, role).
- Slides: please share a Google Slides copy or PPTX 3 business days before the event (so July 11 for the July 14 slot).
- AV: we use Zoom Webinar + local recording. We will send a rehearsal invite ~3 days before the session (20 min).
- Speaker agreement & media release: short form; I'll send for signature once we confirm the date.

Also: would GreenGrid be open to a short written case study post-webinar? We typically publish a 600–800 word Q&A with the speakers and a couple anonymized metric callouts — useful for your comms team. We can share a draft for approval.

Next steps: Elena, can you confirm preferred date from Neha's list? If July 14 works, I'll send the speaker agreement and rehearsal invite.

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai
From: Elena Marquez <elena@greengrid.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@greengrid.ai>, marketing@greengrid.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 17:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Customer Journey Live: GreenGrid — invite to share product story

Hi all,

July 14th at 10:00 PT works for us — Carlos and I will present. Happy to do the post-webinar Q&A case study; send whatever draft you have and we'll review.

We'll share Carlos's slides by July 11 and appreciate the rehearsal invite. One small ask: could you keep the attendee list limited to commercial partners and platform teams (no sales-only prospects)? That's important for us to feel comfortable sharing architecture details.

Thanks, and looking forward to it.

Best,
Elena
